title.narrative: Samoa In-Country Short Term Training 2022 - Professional and youth upskilling

description.narrative:
This activity aims to:
  • Upskill school teachers, Post School Education and Training (PSET) educators and community based trainers in research, report writing, design and delivery of teaching and learning resources and assessments.
  • Improve productivity within the workforce through building Soft Skills, Financial Literacy skills, IT skills, IT Intermediate skills and Social Media Skills.
